authority_classes.bootstrap_only: Deployment, environment, or process bootstrap owns this field. It is not mutable control-plane state and is read before or outside the database authority path.
authority_classes.db_authoritative_hot_reload: PostgreSQL is the durable authority and running pods must converge through an API reload path or the config changefeed without a process restart.
authority_classes.db_authoritative_restart_required: PostgreSQL is the durable authority, but the field changes process wiring or external store/client construction and takes effect only after a pod restart.
